dialogue.origin: おはようございます。お手続きありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you for completing the procedures.

dialogue.origin: 早速今から開始させていただきますが、よろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I'd like to begin our session now, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Likewise.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 私の同僚のことで、相談したいです
dialogue.content: I'd like to talk about a colleague of mine.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。どのようなことか、もう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me a bit more about the situation?

dialogue.origin: 私と同い年なんですが、仕事場が辛いと言っています
dialogue.content: She's the same age as me, and she says she's having a hard time at work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですなそういうことを聞くと戸惑いますね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be unsettling to hear something like that.

dialogue.origin: （そうなんですね、の間違いです、すみません）
dialogue.content: (I meant to say, "I see." My apologies.)

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。50歳にもなっていますが、ずっと働いている職場なんですが
dialogue.content: That's right. She's 50 now and has been working at the same place for a long time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 部署が去年から変わって
dialogue.content: She was transferred to a different department last year.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 人間関係が辛いというんで
dialogue.content: And she says the interpersonal relationships there are difficult.

dialogue.origin: （お話続けてくださいね）
dialogue.content: (Please continue.)

dialogue.origin: 実は、去年から役職がついたんですが、そのタイミングで部長が変わってしまい
dialogue.content: Actually, she got a promotion last year, but at the same time, the department head changed.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 自信がない上に、スタッフからきつく当たられるそうです
dialogue.content: On top of her lack of confidence, she says the staff are being harsh with her.

dialogue.origin: 前から、何度か相談されて
dialogue.content: She's consulted me about it several times before.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 私なりにアドバイスしていたんですが、
dialogue.content: I’ve been offering advice in my own way, but—

dialogue.origin: 先週、もう他の部署に変わりたいと泣き出してしまいました
dialogue.content: Last week, she broke down in tears, saying she wants to transfer to another department.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・そういう様子を見ると辛くなりますね
dialogue.content: I see... It must be painful to see her like that.

dialogue.origin: すみません、部長でなく、部署が変わってでした
dialogue.content: Sorry, it was her department that changed, not the department head.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: That's alright.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、どんなお仕事内容なんでしょうか
dialogue.content: By the way, what kind of work does she do?

dialogue.origin: 看護師なんです
dialogue.content: She's a nurse.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 異動したのが、病棟から特殊な部署なんで
dialogue.content: She transferred from a ward to a specialized unit.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 昔、経験はあるらしいですが
dialogue.content: Apparently she has experience from long ago, but…

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 随分前だと言っていて。50歳ですし、なかなかついていけないところもあって
dialogue.content: She says it was quite a long time ago. And at 50, there are some things that are hard to keep up with.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: また、なかなか口うるさいスタッフもいて
dialogue.content: Also, there's a rather nagging staff member.

dialogue.origin: いわゆるお局様できな
dialogue.content: The so-called "office tyrant" type.

dialogue.origin: そこで経験長くて、なんでも仕切っているらしく
dialogue.content: She's been there a long time and apparently runs everything.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その人が言うことは、絶対的な事で、意見も聞いてももらえない
dialogue.content: Whatever that person says goes, and she won't listen to anyone's opinion.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 最近では、その人が何か話しかけてきたら、動悸がするようになってしまって、私に泣きついてきました
dialogue.content: Recently, she's started getting heart palpitations whenever that person talks to her, and she came to me in tears.

dialogue.origin: そのお局様は、以前からそんな話しはあって
dialogue.content: There have been stories about this 'office tyrant' for a while now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 師長さんは、自分に任せて、あなたはスタッフの方をお願いねーって言われていたそうです。
dialogue.content: The head nurse reportedly told her, “Leave her to me, and you take care of the other staff.”

dialogue.origin: その子は主任なんです
dialogue.content: She's the chief nurse.

dialogue.origin: 相談してきた人です
dialogue.content: She's the one who came to me for advice.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation.

dialogue.origin: 去年から主任になる時も、大丈夫かなぁと不安もあったようですが、嬉しくもあったようです
dialogue.content: When she was promoted to chief nurse last year, she seemed to be anxious about whether she could do it, but she was also happy.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 他の同い年が昇格するのも羨ましいかったんでしょう
dialogue.content: She was probably envious of others her age getting promoted too.

dialogue.origin: そう感じておられるのですね
dialogue.content: So that's how you perceive it.

dialogue.origin: 頑張りやさんだし、キチンとする人なんで、余計に辛いのかも
dialogue.content: She's a hard worker and very meticulous, so maybe that makes it even harder for her.

dialogue.origin: うんうんあなたから見て、そう思うんですね
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. That’s how it seems to you.

dialogue.origin: 私も、お局様は師長に任せて、スタッフが働きやすいように頑張ればと話していて
dialogue.content: I told her to leave the 'office tyrant' to the head nurse and just focus on making it easier for the staff to work.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 彼女は、スタッフのためにとコミュニケーションも取って頑張っていたようです
dialogue.content: It seems she was trying hard to communicate with the staff for their sake.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: だけど、師長さんからも、きつめの言葉を言われたり
dialogue.content: But she also received some harsh words from the head nurse.

dialogue.origin: お局様からもいわれ、それを見ていたスタッフが主任さん大丈夫ですか？って気にするくらいだったようです
dialogue.content: and from the 'office tyrant' as well, to the point where other staff who saw it would ask, 'Are you okay, Chief Nurse?'

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: So that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: スタッフも、お局様には、いい思いをしてなくて、不満はあったようで
dialogue.content: The other staff also didn't have a good impression of the 'office tyrant' and seemed to have complaints.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: でも、スタッフがそう思うことは、主任さんの味方になって来れてるんじゃないかと話したんです
dialogue.content: But I told her that if the staff feel that way, it means they're starting to be on her side.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、そう話してるスタッフも、いざお局様の前となったら味方になってくれないと。
dialogue.content: But she said that even the staff who say that won't back her up when they're in front of the 'office tyrant'.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それで、すっかり自信を無くしてしまったんです
dialogue.content: And because of that, she completely lost her confidence.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね同僚の方のことを考えると、辛くなりますね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be painful when you think about what your colleague is going through.

dialogue.origin: もう部署を変わるしかない、そうでなければ退職しかない。でも辞めたくないというんで、どうするのがいいのかわからないです
dialogue.content: She says her only options are to change departments or quit. But she doesn't want to quit, so I don't know what the best thing to do is.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・同僚の方のご相談を受けながら、一緒に悩んでおられたのですね
dialogue.content: I see… You’ve been struggling alongside her as you listen to her concerns.

dialogue.origin: 看護師の仕事は好きだし、彼女なら主任もできると思うんです
dialogue.content: She loves her job as a nurse, and I think she's capable of being a chief nurse.

dialogue.origin: 主任もできると思うのは、どんなところからでしょうか
dialogue.content: What makes you think she's capable of being a chief nurse?

dialogue.origin: お局様のことが、問題かと思っていたけど、
dialogue.content: I thought the 'office tyrant' was the problem, but—

dialogue.origin: （入れ違ってしまいましたね、すみません）
dialogue.content: (Looks like our messages crossed, my apologies.)

dialogue.origin: とても相手のことを考えられる人で
dialogue.content: She’s very considerate of others.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 学生とか指導もしてきた人なんで、
dialogue.content: She has experience mentoring students and others,

dialogue.origin: 人材育成にも頑張れると思うし
dialogue.content: so I think she can work hard at developing people.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 上司からも、評価もされていたし
dialogue.content: She was also well-regarded by her superiors.

dialogue.origin: 他の主任よりも、真面目に色々取り組まれる姿勢もあって
dialogue.content: And she has a more serious and dedicated approach to her work than other chief nurses.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: たしかに、気をつかいすぎることや、細かいところまで確認したい人なんで、心配性かもしれませんが。
dialogue.content: It's true she might be a bit of a worrier, since she's overly considerate and wants to check every little detail.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・あなたから見て、同僚の方はそのように見えるんですね、
dialogue.content: I see... From your perspective, that's how you see your colleague.

dialogue.origin: 大切なお話をありがとうございます今までのお話を少しまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing this with me. Would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方から、異動先の人間関係が辛いという相談を受けていて
dialogue.content: You've been hearing from your colleague that the relationships in her new department are difficult.

dialogue.origin: 長々とすみません
dialogue.content: Sorry for going on for so long.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いえ、とんでもないですそこまで、同僚の方のことを真剣に考えておられるのがとても伝わってきました
dialogue.content: Not at all. It’s very clear how seriously you’re thinking about your colleague.

dialogue.origin: あなたとしては、同僚の方は主任をやれるほどの人材だと思っているけれども、
dialogue.content: From your perspective, you believe your colleague is capable enough to be a chief nurse, but...

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方は異動か退職しかない、でも辞めたくないと相談され、
dialogue.content: ...she has come to you saying her only options are to transfer or quit, but she doesn't want to quit,

dialogue.origin: どうするのがいいのか分からなくなり、今日ここに来てくださったんですね
dialogue.content: and you've become unsure of what the best course of action is, and that's why you came here today.

dialogue.origin: はい、やめて欲しくないし、主任も頑張ってほしいんです
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't want her to quit, and I want her to do her best as chief nurse.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそのことを同僚の方に伝えてみたのでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. Have you tried telling her that?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 伝えてみて、どんな返事でしたか？
dialogue.content: And how did she respond?

dialogue.origin: 部署を変わることを上司に伝えたいと
dialogue.content: She said she wants to tell her superior that she’d like to transfer to another department.

dialogue.origin: 上司というのは
dialogue.content: By “superior,” I mean—

dialogue.origin: 師長ではなく、もっと上の方に
dialogue.content: not the head nurse, but someone higher up.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね同僚の方が辞めたいと思っていないことを、確認できた感じなんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So it sounds like you were able to confirm that your colleague doesn't really want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 実際に、上司に相談されたのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Did she actually talk to her superior?

dialogue.origin: 自分にもう一度チャンスが欲しいと
dialogue.content: That she wants another chance for herself.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 相談の時間を設けてもらえるなら聞きましたが、
dialogue.content: I heard she asked if they could set aside some time to talk,

dialogue.origin: それからはわかりません
dialogue.content: but I don’t know what's happened since then.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお話を伺って、お伝えしたいことがあるのですがよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Based on what I’ve heard so far, there’s something I’d like to share with you, if that would be alright.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方のご相談を、自分のこととして真剣に考えておられるあなたのお気持ちが、とても強く伝わってきました
dialogue.content: Your feelings of taking your colleague’s concerns to heart as if they were your own come across very strongly.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方も、そんな優しいあなただからこうした相談をされたのだと思います
dialogue.content: I'm sure your colleague confided in you precisely because you are so kind.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方の今の状況が、上司の方に異動の相談をしたところまで、あなたは把握しておられますね
dialogue.content: You're aware of your colleague's situation up to the point where she has asked to speak with her superior about a transfer.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 異動は簡単ではないと思っています
dialogue.content: I don't think a transfer will be easy.

dialogue.origin: なので、今は、同僚の方から上司との相談がどうだったかの報告があるまで、
dialogue.content: So for now, until your colleague reports back to you on how the discussion with her superior went,

dialogue.origin: 今まで同じように、見守ってさしあげることが、同僚の方の心の支えにもなっているのかな、と思うのですが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I wonder if simply continuing to watch over her as you have been might be a great source of emotional support for her. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 見守るって、心配になってつい言葉をかけたくなるものですけれど・・・同僚の方も、あなたの優しさを十分分かっておられると思うので、
dialogue.content: When you're watching over someone, it's natural to get worried and want to say something... but I'm sure your colleague is fully aware of your kindness.

dialogue.origin: 先ほどもいいましたが、異動はなかなか難しいかなと思いますが、
dialogue.content: As I said earlier, I think a transfer will be quite difficult, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 彼女が相談に来れる場所を
dialogue.content: A place where she can come for advice...

dialogue.origin: 私が、そうなれることが大事かなと
dialogue.content: I think it's important that I can be that for her.

dialogue.origin: 思います
dialogue.content: That's what I think.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: あなたが同僚の方に対して、主任が出来るほどの人材であり人柄であることを含めて、
dialogue.content: including your belief that your colleague is capable and has the character to be a chief nurse,

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方の力を信じてさしあげることが、更に同僚の方のパワーになるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: believing in her abilities might empower her even more.

dialogue.origin: 彼女を信じて、もう少し見守ってみます。
dialogue.content: I'll believe in her and watch over her a little longer.

dialogue.origin: 自信を取り戻してもらいたいです。
dialogue.content: I want her to regain her confidence.

dialogue.origin: ええ、おっしゃる通りですねあなたが同僚の方を思い、信じる気持ちは、きっと伝わると私は信じています
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly. I believe that your feelings of concern and trust for your colleague will surely reach her.

dialogue.origin: はい、わかりました
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: あと、大切な人からの相談を受けると知らず知らずのうちに心が疲れることもあるかもしれません
dialogue.content: Also, when you're counseling someone important to you, it can be emotionally draining without you even realizing it.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: ですので、またあなたも気軽に、いつでもここに来ていただければと思います
dialogue.content: So please feel free to come back here anytime yourself.

dialogue.origin: 私まで、落ち込んでると、彼女も相談出来ませんね
dialogue.content: If I get down, she won't be able to talk to me, will she?

dialogue.origin: 聞いて頂いて、少しスッキリしました
dialogue.content: I feel a bit better now that I've been able to talk to you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はいあなたも、そして同僚の方も元気に自分らしく働ける明日になることを、心より願っています
dialogue.content: You're welcome. I sincerely hope that tomorrow will be a day where both you and your colleague can work happily and be yourselves.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。それでは、今日はここで失礼させていただきますね
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. With that, we'll conclude our session for today.

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: （素敵なクライアント役をありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for playing the role of the client so wonderfully.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、初めてで緊張しました。
dialogue.content: Thank you, too. It was my first time, so I was nervous.

dialogue.origin: 初めてだったんですね素晴らしいクライアント役でした・・・！
dialogue.content: It was your first time? You were a fantastic client...!

dialogue.origin: 長い話しを聞いて頂いて、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to my long story.

dialogue.origin: 今、実際の話で
dialogue.content: It's actually a real story.

dialogue.origin: あら、そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: Oh, is that so?

dialogue.origin: 自分じゃ、なかなか力になれてないのかと
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm not really able to help.

dialogue.origin: 人事までは、扱えないし
dialogue.content: I can't handle personnel matters.

dialogue.origin: でも、なんとか頑張ってほしくて
dialogue.content: But I really want her to hang in there.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 相談を受けているだけでも、何かしら効果があれば良いのですが
dialogue.content: I hope just being there to listen has some positive effect.

dialogue.origin: その人の選択や人生はその人のものですものね・・・相談できる人がいる、っていうこと一人じゃないっていう安心感は、その人の力にもなると思いますよ
dialogue.content: A person's choices and life are their own... But having someone to talk to, the reassurance that you're not alone, can give that person strength, I think.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: That's true. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ大切な人のことですもの、気になりますよね
dialogue.content: Not at all. It's about someone important to you, so of course you'd be concerned.

dialogue.origin: それでは、終了させていただきますねありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Well then, let's end the session. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 初めてのラインコも、不安でしたがなんとか終わりよかったです。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: It was my first time with online counseling, and I was anxious, but I'm glad it went well. Thank you.

topic.sub: 同僚との人間関係の悩み
